main_body: multi-story brick building with mansard roof
top_band: blue-grey mansard roof slope and upper roof section (rows 15-42) above an orange trim/cornice (rows 43-45)
evidence: The building displays a visible sloped roof section from rows 15-42, bounded by a distinct cornice (rows 43-45) and eave shadow (row 46) above a tall brick facade (rows 47-142) with inset windows.

style.evidence: The bricks and roof use blocky 2-3 tone fills without the fine grain of the references. Heavy dark outlines around the roof dormers, chimney, and outer edges give it a somewhat flatter, more graphic appearance compared to Beodeul.
